text:
emma: Hey team — day 1. I followed the console onboarding doc but when I try to open the Feature Flags page in staging I get a 403.
emma: Screenshot attached in threads, error text: "403 Forbidden — missing role: ff_toggle" Request ID: s-7f4a9
emma: Also tried the CLI `rwctl feature list` and it returns "permission denied". Not sure who to ping for staging admin?
michael: welcome emma :wave: — should be in the staging-ff-access group after SSO. Which SSO group do you see in your profile?
emma: It shows team=product, groups=[redwood-eng, product-readonly]. No staging-ff-access.
michael: ok likely the group sync didn't include you. I can open a JIRA but pinging infra for a quicker unlock. @josh can you add `staging-ff-access` for emma?
josh: I can do a temp grant. I need emma's org email (the one used for SSO) and whether she needs write or just toggle rights. If write, security wants a brief justification.
emma: emma@redwood.ai — I'll need toggle rights to test a canary. Just testing a frontend toggle for the onboarding flow.
marta: @josh I approve temporary toggle for 72h for onboarding tests. cc: security-approvals@redwood.com for audit trail.
josh: ok giving emma ff_toggle and ff_view in staging for 72h. Tell me if you still see 403 after a few minutes.
onboarding-bot: Heads up — role change takes ~2-3 mins due to SSO cache invalidation.
emma: thanks! tried again and now I can load the flags page but see the flag list dimmed and some flags show "owner: unknown" — is that expected?
sara: Some older flags didn't have owners migrated. For safety don't toggle flags without an owner assigned. If you need to test, create a new test flag with `rwctl feature create --name onboarding_demo --env staging --owner emma`.
emma: quick Q on CLI auth — do I need to run `rw login` or is it automatic with SSO? When I run `rwctl` previously I got "no credentials".
michael: run `rw login --sso` which opens the browser. After that `rwctl` picks up creds. If you hit MFA popup keep it open until you see success in the browser.
emma: `rw login --sso` worked, created the test flag, toggled it, frontend saw change. All good. Thanks everyone.
emma: One more ask — who should I add to notify for prod admin requests if we need to escalate later?
josh: Prod admin escalations go through `security-approvals@redwood.com` and `oncall-infra`. For permanent prod roles we require an ops checklist and manager sign-off.
marta: also loop in your team lead and put the justification in the ticket. I'll add a note to the onboarding doc about owners and temporary grants.
emma: perfect — closing this thread. :thumbsup:
